story.title: One year after 11-0 start, Texas A&M enters rivalry week as a cautionary tale
story.summary: Failed coordinator promotions, a regression under center and a non-existent pass rush turned an expensive roster into one of college football's biggest disasters One year ago, Texas A&M was riding high heading into a historic rivalry game against Texas . The Aggies were an undefeated 11-0 and a shoo-in to their first College Football Playoff, marking one of the best seasons of the 21st Century. Since then, the collapse has been stunning. Texas A&M sits at 4-7 and 1-7 in SEC play, the only win coming against a hapless Arkansas team. Dating back to the rivalry game last season, Texas A&M has lost nine of its last 11 games against Power Four competition, including six straight road games. With that backdrop, the Aggies prepare to host No. 5 Texas, but can barely even play spoiler. Texas A&M is already eliminated from bowl eligibility and has not scored more than 10 points all month.
